lines: 解清玄穿越了。
实验室里摸鱼等数据的功夫，她趴在桌上，眼睛一闭一睁就开启了第二人生。
这很离谱，但更离谱的是穿越后的原主没在她脑子里留下半点记忆，只留下一副灵根炸裂奄奄一息的身体。
解清玄头痛欲裂，满脑子“嗡嗡”的电子轰鸣，一片混沌。
她正盘坐在一处宽阔山洞中的石床之上，面前将近十米的地面上布满了触目惊心的喷射状血迹，再低头一看，她自己身上的道袍也是看不清本色，被染成了一片红，而小腹之处甚至还在不断往外渗着血。她忍着痛将黏连在自己身上的道袍脱下，查看身上伤口。只见她的丹田之处破了一个大洞，内脏皮肉混为一团，仿佛是吞了鞭炮、火药在她肚子里面炸开了一样。
不管是什么东西，她若不赶紧抢救一下自己，那她这辈子也要眼睛一睁一闭的过去了！
洞侧的红木架子上摆满了晶莹小瓶丹药，兴许，那里有能救她的东西。
她含着泪使劲咬牙忍着腹部的剧痛，颤颤巍巍地拾掇了一下自己混成一滩的内脏，往想往丹药架子那边挪。
‘这么多丹药，哪种是能救命的啊！’她还未挪到石床边上，只是看着那些丹药念头一动，便有一瓶刻着【玄灵丹】的小玉瓶从她手上的纳戒中蹦了出来。
解清玄也不知道这是什么灵丹妙药，但只能死马当作活马医地取出一颗泛着珠光的墨绿色小药丸炫进嘴里。
她砸吧砸吧嘴，并没有品出什么味道，但好像那药丸下肚后自己的内脏开始有些瘙痒，只三秒后，她便两眼一翻，又断片栽在床上。
“源述长老？”
“源述长老？”
解清玄是被洞外的一阵呼喊声唤醒的。
这次睁眼她觉得自己的脑子清明了许多，终于是可以开始正常思考了。
‘源述长老？’那是在叫她吗？
外面呼喊‘源述长老’的人又是谁？
解清玄只是下意识地闭上了眼，随后她的思维仿佛膨胀了一般，扩散延展，顺着弯曲的洞穴蔓延到外面。
她好像“看”到，一个身着天青色道袍的中年人恭敬站在洞口，正伏着身子作着揖等候。
许是等得久了，那道人直起身来最后叫了一句：“源述长老！敢问前日渡劫可还顺利？如今可是能出关了？”
这洞穴里就她一个活人，‘源述长老’想来也只能是在叫她，但她没敢吱声回答。
‘出关？’这“关”她出不了一点！
原主没留给她半点记忆，她甚至不知道自己现在是谁！
沉默静候片刻，那中年道人又鞠一躬，然后转身召出一柄宝剑，往上一踏，升空离去。
屏息凝神静候片刻，等到洞中只剩下“滴答滴答”的滴水声时解清玄总算是从方才那“灵视”的状态中回过神来。
‘好在是走了。’她松了口气，又赶紧掀开衣服检查自己的腹部。
那里已是一片光滑洁白的皮肤，上面甚至一点疤痕都没留下，仿佛之前那糟糕的濒死状态只是她的一场恶梦。
“活下来了……”
虽然一头雾水，但她算是活下来了。
【玄灵丹】简直是医学奇迹，那种状态都能给她救回来！解清玄赶紧将手边的【玄灵丹】玉瓶收好，那里面只剩下最后一颗丹药了。
她试着活动了一下初愈如新生的身子。
说来现在这幅新身子是真的比上辈子强健太多了，她不仅没有了上辈子的高度近视，肩膀不酸了腰不疼了，就连身上的肌肉都多了许多。
content_en:
Xie Qingxuan traveled through time.
While fishing in the laboratory and waiting for data, she lay on the table and opened and closed her eyes to start her second life.
This was outrageous, but what was even more outrageous was that the original owner after time travel did not leave any memory in her mind, leaving only a dying body with broken spiritual roots.
Jie Qingxuan had a splitting headache, and his head was filled with electronic buzzing and chaos.
She was sitting cross-legged on a stone bed in a wide cave. The ground nearly ten meters in front of her was covered with shocking spurts of blood. When she looked down, she could not see the true color of her own robe, which was dyed red, and her lower abdomen was even leaking blood. She endured the pain and took off the Taoist robe that was stuck to her body, and checked the wounds on her body. I saw a big hole in her Dantian, and her internal organs, skin and flesh were mixed together, as if she had swallowed firecrackers and gunpowder exploded in her stomach.
"Save..."
No matter what it was, if she didn't save herself quickly, she would have to open and close her eyes for the rest of her life!
The mahogany shelves on the side of the cave were filled with small bottles of crystal pills. Maybe there was something there that could save her.
With tears in her eyes, she gritted her teeth and endured the severe pain in her abdomen. She shakily picked up her internal organs, which were in a puddle, and tried to move toward the elixir shelf.
‘There are so many pills, which one can save lives! ’ Before she moved to the edge of the stone bed, she just looked at the pills and thought about it, and then a small jade bottle with [Xuanling Pill] engraved on it popped out of the ring in her hand.
Xie Qingxuan didn't know what kind of miraculous medicine it was, but he could only take out a small dark green pill with pearlescent light and pop it into his mouth.
She smacked it in her mouth, but she didn't taste any taste, but it seemed that her internal organs started to itch after taking the pill. Only three seconds later, she rolled her eyes and fell on the bed again.
…
"Elder Yuanshu?"
"Elder Yuanshu?"
Xie Qingxuan was awakened by a burst of shouting outside the cave.
When she opened her eyes this time, she felt that her mind was much clearer and she could finally start to think normally.
‘Elder Yuanshu? 'Is that calling her?
Who is the person outside shouting "Elder Yuanshu"?
Jie Qingxuan just closed her eyes subconsciously, and then her thoughts seemed to expand, expand and spread along the curved cave to the outside.
She seemed to "see" a middle-aged man in azure robes standing respectfully at the entrance of the cave, leaning forward and waiting.
Maybe he had been waiting for a long time. The Taoist stood up and called out one last time: "Elder Yuanshu! May I ask if the tribulation went smoothly the day before yesterday? Can you get out of seclusion now?"
She was the only living person in the cave, and 'Elder Yuanshu' could only have called her, but she did not dare to reply.
‘Exit? ’ She can’t get out of this “closed”!
The original owner didn't leave her any memory, and she didn't even know who she was now!
After waiting in silence for a moment, the middle-aged Taoist bowed again, then turned around, summoned a sword, stepped forward, and took off into the air.
After holding his breath and waiting for a moment, Jie Qingxuan finally came back to his senses from the state of "spiritual vision" just now when the only sound of dripping water was left in the cave.
‘Fortunately, he’s gone. ’ She breathed a sigh of relief and quickly opened her clothes to check her abdomen.
There was already a piece of smooth and white skin, with not even a scar left on it, as if the previous terrible near-death state was just a nightmare for her.
"Survived..."
Although she was confused, she managed to survive.
[Xuanling Pill] is simply a medical miracle, it can save her from that state! Xie Qingxuan quickly put away the jade bottle of [Xuanling Pill] at hand, and there was only the last pill left in it.
She tried to move her newly healed body.
It can be said that her new body is much stronger than that of her previous life. Not only does she no longer have the high degree of myopia she had in her previous life, her shoulders are no longer sore and her waist is no longer painful, she even has a lot more muscles on her body.
